# Sortd Money

> Sortd Money is an iPhone spending tracker. Apple Pay taps log themselves through one Shortcuts automation, and receipts can come from Gmail (read-only) or the camera. Purchases are stored on the iPhone, with optional encrypted iCloud backup to the user's own iCloud. No ads, no tracking across apps, no bank passwords. Anonymous usage counts and crash reports (never amounts, shops or card digits) can be turned off in Settings. Signing in with Apple or Google is optional.

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 26 or later
- Price: free. Every feature, including Gmail receipts, the receipt camera, Insights, subscriptions and bills, and budgets. An optional tip jar unlocks nothing.
- Currencies: 30+ currencies, converted at that day's European Central Bank rate.
- Status: not released yet. The TestFlight beta is planned to open around 9 October 2026; sign up to get the link.
